observations.body: Raised life puts off an old self and its divisions. If then you were raised together with Christ, seek the things that are above, where Christ is, seated on the right hand of God. where there can’t be Greek and Jew, circumcision and uncircumcision, barbarian, Scythian, bondservant, or free person; but Christ is all, and in all.
